title: [review] project-LICHEN-worker6-2729: 8 test failures after protect_response refactor
description:
8 tests fail after commit e60cbb8267:

1. `response_without_piv_requires_requester_identity` — MISSING IDENTITY CHECK: `protect_response` returns `Ok` when it should return `InvalidParam` (no `request_kid` validation). Tracked separately as project-LICHEN-worker6-trau.

2. `test_roundtrip_with_0xff_in_class_e_options` — `Context::new()` sets `active=false`, `TestProtect::protect_request` calls `reserve_sender` which returns `ReservationError::Conflict` mapped to `SeqExhausted`. Test uses direct `Context::new()` instead of `new_ephemeral()` (which sets `active=true`).

3. `oversized_explicit_piv_response_does_not_poison_valid_retry` — `unprotect_response` returns `Err(Replay)` at line 2669 when expecting `Ok`. Possible replay window issue in `unprotect_response`.

4. `response_without_piv_is_one_shot_per_request` — related to no-PIV response one-shot semantics.

5. `delayed_explicit_piv_ordinary_response_ignores_peer_replay_window`
6. `dropped_pending_response_preserves_committed_window_across_large_jump`  
7. `fresh_context_activates_only_after_atomic_registration`
8. `public_unprotect_rejects_malformed_inner_options`

Need to verify which of failures 3-8 are caused by this commit vs pre-existing from earlier commits in chain.
